adjudication.rationale: In `AddGuestsDialog`, `isInvalidEmail` is set to `true` on failed validation (`handleAdd` else-branch), but it is never cleared when validation later succeeds. On subsequent clicks where `ZAddGuestsInputSchema.safeParse(multiEmailValue)` succeeds, the code calls `addGuestsMutation.mutate(...)` without `setIsInvalidEmail(false)`, so the red validation banner can remain visible even after the user fixes the emails (until the dialog is closed or Cancel is pressed, which explicitly resets it).
